sources.snippet: Introduction Hy-MT2 is a multilingual translation model series open-sourced by Tencent Hunyuan. It includes three sizes — Hy-MT2-1.8B, Hy-MT2-7B, and Hy-MT2-30B-A3B — all supporting translation across 33 languages and 5 Chinese ethnic minority / dialect translation pairs.
